title: Ford Pampanga 25th Anniversary
excerpt: Ford Pampanga has made a significant...
description: Ford Pampanga has made a significant mark as it gained recognition at the recent Ford Dealer Convention held at Okada Manila. The dealership which champions superior customer service and dedication to innovation has been awarded as the Top Selling Provincial Dealer, Top Selling Dealer for Territory, and one of its Sales Consultant Don Hillary Guttierez placed 3rd among the nominees. Behind the said achievement are the incredible people which served as their pillar for success – the valued clients, employees, sales and service personnel, business and bank partners, and all involved stakeholders. These prestigious awards reflects the dealership's continued commitment to quality products and services, and its persistence towards unparalleled satisfaction. Ford Philippines' executives headed the awarding ceremony and expressed their appreciation to the awardees. “We would like to congratulate our outstanding dealer employees and teams for their excellent performance that greatly contributed to the success of Ford Philippines last year. We hope that these accomplishments will further inspire and motivate the rest of our dealer community to continue delivering a great sales and service experience to our customers.” says Mike Breen, Ford Philippines' managing director. The strong commitment to excellence has made this possible and is a proven testimony that a collective effort leads to fruitful rewards.

title: Ford Metro Baguio Celebrates a Decade of Excellence
excerpt: Another Laus Auto Group dealership marks its milestone…
description: Another Laus Auto Group dealership marks its milestone as Ford Metro Baguio steps into its 10th year. Filled with pride and gratitude, serving the countryside by transforming lives through providing automotive needs and mobilizing the community has always been the lasting commitment of each LausGroup Ford dealer. In October 2, 2014 the passion to serve ignited, giving way to more possibilities to be explored by the people of Baguio City, and its neighboring areas in the Cordillera Administrative Region. Not only its people were able to experience and own quality vehicles, but also an opportunity for employment and professional growth became achievable. The celebration began with a holy mass, followed by a program which recognized the employees who have worked with the company for 5-10 years. Through this appreciation event, they were able to realize their exemplary contributions to the thriving business. All employees from the sales, admin, service, upper management, bank partners, and various guests were present during the celebration. And to honor the rich culture in which the company operates, a group of indigenous Igorot people were invited to commemorate the special occasion through their traditional ethnic dance. Of course, the celebration isn't complete without a feast of delectable dishes. The guests enjoyed the rest of the day through a shared meal over conversations. Looking back, it was truly a decade built through trust and greatness that brought the dealership to where it is today. Behind this remarkable milestone are the dedicated people who shared their skills and talent in order to deliver products and services at their best quality. This is everyone's triumph that is achieved through collective deeds, a shared success that shall serve as an inspiration to stay great for the more years ahead.
